motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: The Commander's watching me now, I need to work harder.

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: You're really nice to me, I'll remember this.

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: Is there nothing we can do? I hope I'm not to blame...

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: Don't worry, next time I'll pay them back in kind!

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: You really are heartless, aren't you? Can't you be gentler to a little girl?

motions.name: login
motions.line: It's a new day, Commander. Did you miss me?

motions.name: login
motions.line: It's a new day, Commander. Did you miss me?

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: Hehe, the Commander's going to praise me. Don't get jealous now, everyone.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: It seems like I'm very popular. Is it because I can understand everyone's words?

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: You need to cultivate an appreciation for things from a young age, otherwise you'll end up with weird tastes like FAL when you grow up.

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: Hold tightly onto my hand, Commander. I'll be very upset if you get lost~

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Commander...this moment has finally come....<>The more people and affairs I deal with, the more I lose myself, but you always pulled me back when I needed help the most.<>Thank you. Please let me stay with you from now on and become your most trusted partner.

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Working all the time and putting me aside is a no-no, okay? Keep me company every now and then~
